ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Alivus Life Sciences Limited (formerly Glenmark Life Sciences Limited) has formally informed stock exchanges about upcoming investor/analyst meetings scheduled for September 10th and 11th, 2026. The September 10th meeting will be an in-person session in Mumbai with various institutional investors and mutual funds, representing a routine disclosure of ongoing investor relations activities. This procedural announcement carries no immediate material impact or significant red flags, though specific details for the September 11th meeting are currently omitted.
